apps.description: Strava turns every run, ride, and hike into a shareable map with deep stats. Chase segment records and stay motivated by your friends' activity feed.
Hevy is the fastest way to log a lifting session. Build routines, watch your volume and PRs climb, and follow other lifters for programming ideas.
MyFitnessPal makes nutrition tracking effortless with a huge food database and barcode scanning. Hit your calorie and macro targets without guessing.
GainFrame grades your progress photos with AI and tracks body composition over time, so you can see real change the scale can't show. The missing piece in your fitness stack.
Nike Run Club pairs guided runs and adaptive training plans with audio coaching, making it the easiest way to go from first mile to race day.

caption: The 5 apps living on every serious lifter's home screen in 2026 👀 Which one are you missing? #fitnessapps #gymtok #fitnesstech #progresspics #gymmotivation
